# Big Vin - Grind to Win
> Free sports model that compares its own fair point spread with the sportsbook line. Edge = the gap in points. Picks are saved before kickoff and graded honestly on paper bankrolls; no real wagers.

## Data
- Site: https://big-vin.lestercrafton.workers.dev/
- Board: /api/slate?sport=nfl|cfb|nba|wnba|cbb|nhl|mlb[&date=YYYY-MM-DD]
- Results: /api/results?sport=...
- Learning log: /api/learning

## MCP
- Read-only server: big-vin/mcp/server.mjs (stdio, or --http for /mcp). See big-vin/mcp/README.md.
